notes.title: UI Function Update
notes.notes:
This month we have been focusing on improving UI and functionality. 

We have had a UI overhaul, redoing our game function buttons & introducing a floating setting COG that expands into board controls. We hope this will help Capslock feel less crowded and for the features of the game to be easier to access ! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/53185674fe6f7f0249a85e34f7e2c33c888011be.png

We have also been working on our typing game, fixing up bugs and introducing new sentences. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/c84f589c5dd5b4e49e02ae439271fcfab0788477.png

Our customer offer system has also had a lot of work done! Including more requests, a higher chance of a large tip, and bug fixes for a smoother experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/392637fa651533a3991319dd68f1e0fb73ed554a.png

More to come soon!
Sticky Platypus
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/15833810d38d873e2bf69fcc67fbfadcb34cbed5.png

notes.title: Month #2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
This update brings two small enhancements:


 Symbols no longer becoming blurry when zooming out
 Patched an issues where 3D key caps don't appear on the store
 Minor crashing / loss of save patches 


Much more coming soon! We cant wait to share our next update with you guys <3 warning; may be spooky ;)

notes.title: Capslock Early Access Release !
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/91523c07f4f70ba49e89e4aaa370fb0c5f54c158.png

Hey Cappers,

Welcome to the official early access release of Capslock! We are so thrilled to be putting out our cozy keyboard designer and are very excited to see your designs ! Capslock has been in development for just shy of a year and it is our very first game (from a hobbyist duo), we’ve had a blast learning the ropes and we hope you have as much fun playing Capslock as we had making it ! 

For the first 7 days of release, Capslock will be on a 10% discount. 🎉🎉 

We would like to give a huge thank you to those who played our game in its Beta phase and gave us amazing feedback. We appreciate each and every hour of gameplay!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/8c01ba168e25c3a7ad46a3bfb6a5c9dc08e9c9e2.png

Recently, Capslock has had a huge UI upgrade & this has been our focus for the last few weeks of development. 

Updated Catalogue

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/e357431e94b7aefe83570cc880ad7aec6c1e455a.png
Updated key menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/74aa43430dc0f3e25a34e7d58d051a50e9336736.png

Capslock is released with 263 custom keycaps, 132 skins and 276 symbols ! We also have 9 custom fonts to choose from, a wide range of coloured key options, and unique lighting choices.

In our release, the newest content features more colour variations! (for a full list see bottom of post)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/be1b4e1bcd50782d39b828dd140603974b53614a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004990/c9531a583600fe66d89c7b5d8a761cd20376392c.png


DEVELOPMENT

Since our last update, we've been hard at work on the following;

 System-wide UI revamp
 Custom text improvements
 Text appearing as you type feature
 Tooltip UI improvements
 New title UI
 Improvements on randomise & unslot functions
 Items player cannot afford in shop are now greyed out
 Keys selected disappear while using the colour picker on fonts and icons, they reappear when selected - to allow the user to see colour choices in real time
 Custom lighting now sells for value
 Added DLSS and FSR2 support
 Post processing and rendering improvements
 Added Depth of Field and Shadow control
 New feature song
 Upgraded SFX
 Certain keys now have custom SFX when placed: piano, vinyl, bell, duck
 Feature music streamlined between boards/scenes
 Splash background image 

We hope you enjoy these features and we look forward to seeing what you create ! Join our Discord and post your designs, we would love to see unique boards and hear your thoughts.

Capslock is in early access, and we are very open to opinions on what you are hoping from the game or how we could improve. Please also feel free to send through any bugs/glitches to our Discord or Steam discussions.

Thank you to everyone who is interested in Capslock . Keep an eye out, this is just the beginning !  

Best of luck with your designs!

Love,
Sticky Platypus
